title: Technological capability and industrialization in Africa
summary: The paper examines the spatial dynamics of technological capability in Africa and its interdependence with industrial development, using a framework that measures capability along four dimensions: technology precondition, technology infrastructure, technology import and technology effort.
keyFindings: Levels of technological capability differ strongly across African countries.
Technological capability and industrial development are interdependent across countries.
This interdependence is propagated through intra-African regional trade.
methods: Composite technological capability index for African countries with spatial analysis.
